overview: The main change is authenticated timer storage with optimistic actions and floating controls across routes. Other commits reorganize content ownership, improve navigation and diagrams, and document the timer architecture.

groups.title: Authenticated storage and optimistic timer actions
groups.analysis: Timer gains owner-only Google authentication and Turso-backed daily records. Database and engine modules handle persistence and timer rules, while an optimistic mutation controller projects pending actions and reconciles server snapshots. Backup import/export, per-task speed controls, shared clock and audio scheduling, and retained form drafts are part of this change. A follow-up validates authentication configuration and returns actionable variable-specific diagnostics. These diffs introduce the implementation; they do not establish production reliability or measured latency.

groups.title: Account access and floating task controls
groups.analysis: Google account controls appear in the top bar. A floating timer dock exposes progress, speed, and task actions outside the Timer page, with selection among running tasks and a retained paused task. Positioning follows the mobile navigation surface and reserves clearance for article back-to-top controls.

groups.title: Content ownership, navigation, and diagrams
groups.analysis: Content records move from central data files into their owning routes, with consumers updated accordingly. Lab navigation and domain icons are revised, article contents distinguish top-level numbering from nested bullets, and section description spacing is reduced. A shared interactive flow renderer replaces the navigation diagram’s local rendering implementation.

groups.title: Timer documentation and compact controls
groups.analysis: The Timer details page documents storage, source files, and component relationships with interactive diagrams. Smaller follow-ups shorten Add Task on mobile and compact toolbar controls and the completed heading. A completed dark-mode-removal plan is deleted. The later working-tree card redesign and home-page edits are outside this committed snapshot.
